name: judged-large-output-compressed-stored-then-deduplicated
description: The judge (a fake server both lanes call) says a 15 KB build log needs only its errors and summary: the result becomes the excerpt with a pointer to a stored copy; reading a copy of the file becomes a duplicate note without a second request. The original is pointed at the fake server with its own typesafeBackend endpoint (loopback http is allowed) and the port with TYPESAFE_BASE_URL. The stored copy lives in pi-warden-output-<random> (the original randomizes it on every run), so the scenario's normalize rule masks that name.
